description: Check whether a DNS change has spread: asks the domain's own authoritative name server (when reachable) and 8 big public resolvers (Cloudflare, Google, OpenDNS, AdGuard, NextDNS, Control D, CleanBrowsing, AliDNS) over DoH, marks which are up to date, and gives the remaining cache time (TTL) of stale answers.
name: check_dns_propagation
